# Monitor lifecycle

97 records support this lifecycle stage.

- [Amazon CloudWatch](https://aws.amazon.com/cloudwatch) — AWS monitoring and observability service.
- [Apache SkyWalking](https://skywalking.apache.org) — APM platform for distributed tracing, metrics, and service topology.
- [AppNeta](https://www.broadcom.com/products/software/network-management/appneta) — Network performance monitoring.

- [cardamon](https://github.com/dominikhei/cardamon) — Cleanup tool that finds unused Prometheus metrics via Grafana and generates drop rules for them.

- [checkmk](https://checkmk.com) — IT monitoring platform with open source Raw Edition and paid enterprise editions.

- [Datadog](https://github.com/DataDog) — Full-stack cloud monitoring, log management, and APM.
- [dnsglobe](https://github.com/514-labs/dnsglobe) — Terminal UI for tracking global DNS propagation across public resolvers.
- [Dozzle](https://dozzle.dev) — Self-hosted real-time Docker and container log viewer with alerting, remote hosts, and Kubernetes support.
- [Dynatrace](https://github.com/dynatrace) — Application performance monitoring and observability platform.
- [Elastic APM Server](https://www.elastic.co/observability/application-performance-monitoring) — APM intake/processing for Elastic Observability (agents + server + UI).

- [flow](https://github.com/programmersd21/flow) — Terminal tool for visualizing live network traffic and behavior.
- [Fluent Bit](https://fluentbit.io) — Fast and lightweight log processor.

- [GoAlert](https://goalert.me) — On-call alert and escalation management.

- [Grafana](https://grafana.com) — Visualization and analytics for metrics.
- [Grafana Alloy Deploy](https://grafana.com/docs/alloy/latest/set-up/deploy) — Docs for deploying Grafana Alloy (telemetry collector/agent for logs/metrics/traces).

- [HyperDX](https://www.hyperdx.io) — Observability and troubleshooting platform.
